question: Grupo Oleo Lab manufacturer company
markdown:
Grupo Oleo-Lab, S.A. de C.V.
is a
Mexican production and B2B manufacturing company founded in 2000
. Headquartered in Zapopan, Jalisco, with roots in Michoacán, it specializes in the extraction, processing, and transformation of natural plant oils and extracts—notably avocado oil—serving global supply chains.
